claim.claim-text: 1. A method of controlling a robotic mower, wherein the robotic mower comprises a self-propelled module and a mowing module, the mowing module is provided with a first working mode and a second working mode, characterized in that, the method comprises the steps of:
2. The method according to claim 1, wherein the method further comprises:

marking the working area except the mowed area as an un-mowed area, and controlling, by the robotic tool, the mowing module to perform the self-propelled mowing operation in the first working mode when the robotic tool enters the un-mowed area.
3. The method according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the first working mode is a normal mowing mode, and the second working mode is a stop mowing mode.
4. The method according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the mowed area is marked by a positioning module or a camera module.
5. The method according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the positioning module is an RTK (real-time kinematic) positioning module.

6. The method according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein when power of the robotic mower is insufficient, the robotic mower is controlled to return to a charger station and a return point of the robotic tool is recorded, the robotic mower returns to the return point and continues to move along an original path after charging is completed.

7. The method according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the method further comprises: controlling the robotic mower to move along a boundary of the working area, and collecting and storing a position of the boundary of the working area to obtain a working area map.

8. The method according to claim 7, wherein controlling the robotic mower to move along the boundary of the working area, and collecting and storing the position of the boundary of the working area to obtain the working area map includes: collecting current position information; evaluating a path between the current position and a next position to obtain path information; determining a position collection working mode from the current position to the next position according to the path information, wherein the position collection working mode includes at least one of a fixed period collection mode, a fixed distance collection mode, or a manual mode.

9. The method according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the robotic mower will first randomly select a path map from a pre-stored path map set each time it runs, and then follow the selected path map to move and work.
10. The method according to claim 9, wherein the path map set is a path map planned in advance according to different traveling angles by the robotic mower in the working area.
11. The method according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the first working mode is the normal mowing mode, and the second working mode is set to a low speed mowing mode.

13. The robotic mower according to claim 12, wherein the robotic mower further comprises a positioning module to provide position information of the robotic mower to mark the mowed area, and the positioning module is an RTK (real-time kinematic) positioning module.
14. The robotic mower according to claim 12, wherein the robotic mower further comprises a camera module for identifying a mowed state to mark the mowed area.
15. The robotic mower according to claim 13, wherein the position module is detachable.
